model.title: A resolution designating October 26, 2026, as the "Day of the Deployed."

summary.text: The resolution designates October 26, 2026, as the Day of the Deployed, honoring members of the U.S. Armed Forces who are serving overseas and their families. It asks people across the country to reflect on the service of these members, whether they are currently deployed, served in the past, or will serve in the future. It also encourages Americans to mark the day with appropriate ceremonies and activities.
